title: sales/cs curation canvas + fast-scope brief for high-touch enterprise asks
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Problem: Sales and CS surface a high volume of non-bug enterprise feature asks with inconsistent detail and no shared quick-scope artifact. This causes slow handoffs to Product & Eng and noisy prioritization calls.

Goal: Create a lightweight 'Curation Canvas' and a one-page 'Fast-Scope Brief' that enable Sales/CS reps to capture necessary signals quickly and allow PMs to make a first-pass prioritization decision within one working day. Deliver a triage rubric, templates, and a short onboarding doc for Sales/CS. Integrate the brief into our existing intake form and link to the canonical ticketing flow.

Scope: Template design (canvas + one-pager), rubric with scoring axes (customer value, revenue signal, implementation complexity, compliance risk, strategic alignment), sample filled briefs from 6 recent asks, process doc for reviewers, and a lightweight automation to surface new briefs into the PM weekly review board. Not included: full intake UI rebuild (separate initiative).
acceptance_criteria: Curation Canvas artifact created and reviewed by 2 PMs and 1 Sales leader
Fast-Scope Brief template available in Drive and embedded into the intake form
Triage rubric defined with scoring guidance and example scores for 6 historical asks
Process doc published with clear handoff steps and SLAs (PM first-pass within 24 hours)
Automation: new briefs tagged and appear on PM weekly review board (proof-of-concept webhook or zap)
Run 2 pilot signoffs (Sales rep + assigned PM) on live incoming requests
